_comment: schemas/simple_task.json -- a minimal personal task FSM.
Use this as a starting template when building your own domain schema.

inbox.label: Inbox
inbox.description: A newly captured task waiting to be reviewed.

review.label: Review
review.description: Decide whether to start the task now or defer it.
review.question: Given the task context, should it be started immediately or deferred? Answer with one of: start, defer.

in_progress.label: In Progress
in_progress.description: The task is actively being worked on.

deferred.label: Deferred
deferred.description: The task is parked for later.
